strategy.name: intraday_sma_or_flat_start_reentry_grid
strategy.description: 2021-01-04 起先持有现金，等待第一个普通买入信号后全仓持有 QQQ；持仓时由成本止损、短均线慢性转弱、SMA25/30/35 当日变化率同时快速转弱或 SMA200 下穿中的任一规则全仓卖出；空仓时由卖出价上方强制买回、SMA200 上穿或短均线恢复中的任一规则全仓买回。本实验只扫描强制买回幅度 R=0% 至 10%。
strategy.buy_rule: 初始空仓且没有上次卖价，因此仅允许动态 SMA200 上穿或短均线恢复产生第一笔买入；以后空仓时再额外允许价格达到上次实际卖出价的 1+R。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时 OR：成本价 -1.5%；短均线平均变化率此前连续 6 日为负且当日仍为负并跌破动态 SMA130；此前连续 2 日短均线平均变化率为负且当日动态 SMA25、SMA30、SMA35 各自变化率全部不高于 -0.20%；动态 SMA200 下穿。
strategy.signal_time: 每个交易日开始前，仅用截至前一交易日 Close 的历史计算该日条件单及动态阈值公式；盘中是否触发由该日常规时段调整后 OHLC 判定。
strategy.execution_time: 若前 Close 到当日 Open 已越过阈值，按当日 Open；否则常规时段 OHLC 触及阈值时按精确理论阈值；零滑点、零费用；每天最多一笔成交。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only，初始 100,000 美元现金；触发后全仓持有或全现金，允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 2021-01-04 起空仓等待；第一笔正常买入成交前不计入策略与 Buy & Hold 的正式比较区间。

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: At the strategy's first actual buy fill, invest the same 100,000 USD in QQQ at that identical fill price; compare both paths only from that date through 2026-08-04 Close.

reporting.reuse_review: Promote the accepted v2 report to v3. The visible-window Y-axis logic is extended so the lower derivative panel independently follows the visible dates and selected derivative traces, while old validated v2 runs remain reproducible.

research.hypothesis: Starting flat and requiring all three short-SMA derivatives to reach -0.20% may reduce unintended early exposure and noisy fast-drop exits; the one-dimensional forced-rebuy grid reveals whether R has a broad, smooth useful region.
research.primary_metric: Report the full R=0% through 10% response for total return, CAGR, Sharpe, maximum drawdown, exposure and trade count; compare every case with a common QQQ benchmark starting at the first strategy fill.
research.selection_rule: No parameter is promoted or silently selected. R=5% is predeclared only as the trade-marker display case; report the sample-best CAGR and Sharpe as descriptive extrema alongside all 11 cases.
research.validation_plan: Every R case must match PyBroker and an independently coded cash/share ledger for daily cash, shares, equity, every order and every closed trade; all cases must share the same first normal buy fill.
research.promotion_criteria: None in this full-sample grid. A later experiment must lock a robust region and use walk-forward or held-out evaluation before simulation.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject if any case seeds a position, uses forced re-entry before a real sell, starts its benchmark on a different fill, does not require all three individual short-SMA derivatives at -0.20%, trades more than once a day, or diverges from the independent ledger.
